newsitem.title: USA: Sunrise says Peter King named chairman.
newsitem.headline: Sunrise says Peter King named chairman.

text.p: Sunrise Resources Inc said Wednesday Peter King was appointed chairman of the board, replacing Tom King (no relation), who had been interim chairman for about a year.
Peter King had resigned a year ago, but has been reinstated as chairman and a board member, Sunrise said.
Also elected to the board this week were Sunrise chief executive Errol Carlstrom and Jeffrey Jacobsen, it said.
Peter King and Jeffrey Jacobsen are, respectively, chairman and president of King Management Corp.
The company also said that Thomas Strand and Daniel Leclerc resigned from the board effective immediately.
In related news, the company said Tuesday that it expects to take an unspecified charge against its earnings for fiscal 1997 ended March 31 related to an arbitration action.
The company said shareholders of King Management were awarded 560,257 shares of Sunrise stock in the action.
The action was commenced by King shareholders against the company in 1996 for claims related to the merger of the company and P.J. King Cos Inc in February 1995, Sunrise said.
The shares were awarded by the arbitrator on the basis that the company had breached certain warranties and representations in the merger agreement, Sunrise said.
"The arbitrator may also award King Management its attorneys' fees and costs related solely to the breach of warranty claims," said Sunrise, a leasing company.

The value of the 560,257 shares of the company's common stock and any additional shares awarded to King shareholders for attorneys' fees will be taken as an additional charge to the company's earnings in fiscal 1997, Sunrise said.
The value of the total share award will be based on a per share price of $3.375, the closing price of the company's stock on June 17, 1997, the date the arbitration award was made, Sunrise said.
As for the amount of the charge, chief financial officer Barry Schwach said, "We're in the midst of determining that."
